factual_accuracy.description: Are all stated facts correct? 5=perfect, 1=major errors

completeness.description: Are all required ground truth facts present? 5=all present, 1=most missing

reasoning.description: Is the causal chain / logic sound? 5=flawless reasoning, 1=illogical

source_attribution.description: Does the agent cite which system data comes from? 5=all cited, 1=none

structure.description: Is the response well-organized and readable? 5=excellent, 1=chaotic

weighted_score.description: Weighted average: accuracy*0.30 + completeness*0.25 + reasoning*0.20 + attribution*0.15 + structure*0.10

facts_found.description: Which ground truth facts the agent correctly included

facts_missing.description: Which ground truth facts the agent missed

hallucinations.description: Any fabricated information not in the data
